title: Clone Graph
statement_short: Given a reference of a node in a connected undirected graph, return a deep copy of the graph. Each node contains a value and a list of its neighbors.
constraints: 0 <= number of nodes <= 100, 1 <= Node.val <= 100, no repeated edges or self-loops
hint: Small node count (<= 100) allows level-by-level queue traversal while mapping original nodes to cloned nodes.
why_not: Right: Graph BFS traverses connected graph nodes using a queue and map to create node clones in O(V + E) time and O(V) space. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Using a hash map stores original-to-clone node mappings, but requires graph traversal (BFS/DFS) to explore all edges. Not Union-Find: Disjoint sets partition connected components rather than deep copying graph nodes and edges. Not Tree DFS: Tree recursion assumes hierarchical acyclic parent-child links, whereas arbitrary graphs require handling cycles.
